items.title: 35 MİLYARLIK SORULAR | KARGA KAHVALTISINI YAPMADAN | 26 EKİM PAZARTESİ | TİMUR SOYKAN
items.transkript: Good morning. Good morning to the  beautiful people of this beautiful  country. Actually, I always started  with "good morning, good morning, good  morning," but I can't start that way  anymore. I don't feel like it. Because  with Murat Arel and İsmail Arı— those wonderful colleagues, those fine  colleagues, those good journalists—in  prison, we cannot wake up to  enthusiastic mornings. We can't start  mornings with enthusiasm, but we  continue the struggle. Because they  will continue to write and report from  inside prison, too. And we will  continue to do journalism and carry on  the struggle for journalism on the  outside. It is Monday, October 26th; we  are starting a new week. Welcome to " The Crow’s Breakfast." First of all,  I want to start with a thank you. Thank  you so, very much. Because on Saturday,  we were out on the streets as  journalists all across Turkey—we were  protesting—but most importantly, our  people did not leave us alone. Everyone  was by our side, and together with  thousands of people, we marched in  Kadıköy, Istanbul. In Ankara, Adana,  Eskişehir, Edirne—that is, in Van,  in Diyarbakır—in so many cities,  people marched alongside journalists.  What did they march for? For the right  to receive information, for the right  to be informed, and for freedom for  journalists. As we have said, they want  to cover your eyes, your ears, and your  mouths so you don't learn how you are  being governed, or about the corruption , the theft, and the injustices. The  way to do this is to silence  journalists first, to create a country  where journalists play "the three  monkeys." But we are not surrendering  to this. Despite all this pressure,  journalists continue their struggle for  the truth. Look, I am underlining once  again that you must never, ever get  used to this injustice. Look, I will  come to Murat. I will talk about Murat,  but İsmail Arı has been in Sincan  Prison for 5 days now; he has entered  prison for the second time this year,  in 2026—my young colleague from  BirGün newspaper—and not because his  report was wrong. Not because his  report contained an error, and not  because the photo he shared on Twitter  was a crime. Even though there is no  crime, he is in prison right now  because they wanted to silence him, to  intimidate him, to escalate the climate  of fear, and because of a complaint by  Ebubekir Şahin, the former RTÜK  president. He is in prison, and what  for? He published a photo. In that  photo is Osman Arıkan Nacar, who is  also mentioned in this fund scandal. He  is one of the owners of the EATA  company. A former Ministry of Health  bureaucrat. How does a Ministry of  Health bureaucrat become so wealthy  later on, become a holding owner, and  establish a massive company? He also  makes a killing from those shares. That  doesn't become a problem. He returns 81  million TL. And he walks around freely.  But İsmail Arı is sitting in prison,  and the charge for which he is in  prison is "publicly disseminating  misleading information." Now, Fethi  Yıldız is one of the architects of  this law, a figure from the MHP. When  this law was being passed, AKP and MHP  deputies kept saying, "Oh, this won't  be applied to journalists." It says it  must threaten public safety solely to  incite anxiety and panic in the public.  You have to commit that crime by  threatening public peace, security, and  in five other distinct categories. But  look, it already starts with "solely."  Yes, solely to incite panic in the  public. To create a public safety issue  among the people. Which part of a  report about Ebubekir Şahin threatens  public safety? Of course, there is no  such thing. Or which part of it causes  such panic among the public? Of course,  there isn't one. But Fethi Yıldız  defended the law again. He made a  statement like that on his social media  account. Everyone said, "Look, you are  listing five conditions here for a  journalist to even be tried under this  law, let alone be arrested." None of  the five apply to İsmail Arı. None of  the five apply to Selahattin Günday.  Look, none of the five apply to Mustafa  Balcı. They don't apply to Şaban  Seviç either. They don't apply to any  of them. But what is it? Arbitrary  application. You only need one clause.  No one is looking at the law anyway.  Now, however, the situation with Murat  Arel is different. For Murat Arel,  there is an accusation where, in the  same way, the boundaries of reason and  logic are gone, and injustice and  lawlessness have reached their peak.  Isn't that right? So, friends, this is  Murat Arel's crime. I will say it again  and again. I will say it without  getting tired. Please, you don't get  tired either. Do not get used to it. As  Murat says, don't get used to it and  don't be afraid. Do not lose your  ability to be surprised. A person who  has confessed to money laundering  abroad, in Germany, and his two German  partners, who are also alleged to be  fraudsters. They are doing business  with the Sarıgüls. Financial dealings . And then, while researching the  Gökçek case, they reach Murat Arel  and tell him, "We are laundering  Mustafa Sarıgül's dirty money." Murat  Arel asks for documents. They don't  send documents for days. They don't  send documents for days. It's not  enough that they don't send documents  for days. They only send videos. And  Murat says, "I can't make news with  these videos." Murat was recording all  of them. All of them were presented to  the prosecutor's office. "Can you make  news with just one video?" he asks. " Can you make news with a few photos?"  he asks. Then they send a SWIFT  document. Regarding sending 100 million  euros to Emir Sarıgül. And the  Sarıgüls, or rather Sarıgül's  lawyer, claim that these documents are  fake. And Murat continues his  investigation. Look, in one country, a  prosecutor might not write an  indictment for 2 or 3 years. No one  says, "You didn't write the indictment,  let's throw you in jail." A journalist  can sometimes work on a story for a  year. No one tells that journalist, " Why are you working on this story for a  year?" They don't say, "I'll put you in  jail if you don't finish it on time."  But a person who admits to money  laundering, an alleged fraudster, a  person in Germany, has an impression  and says this: "We gave the documents  to Murat Arel.""After that, the Mustafa  Sarıgüls threatened us.""We were left  with the impression that Murat Arel  gave the documents to Mustafa Sarıgül ." Based on that person's impression,  one of Turkey's journalists is being  held today between four walls in  Kandıra Prison. And the worst part is,  they say: "Helping an organization  without being a member of the Mustafa  Sarıgül organization." Mustafa  Sarıgül and his lawyers aren't even  aware that Murat Arel was preparing  this news. The suspects tell me that I  prepared the news, and I tell them that  Murat is preparing the news. How else  can we explain this? Murat presented  dozens of pieces of evidence to the  prosecutor's office. Correspondence,  footage. Because these people are dark  figures, he was worried they might set  him up. He knew these people were  recording everything. He was recording  too, and he presented the evidence of  this. There is none. No real madmen, no  correspondence, no records. What? The  person who confesses to Sinan Çipin's  money laundering is highly reputable.  Are we going to get used to journalists  being jailed based on his word? Are we  going to lose our sense of outrage here  too? Is it a crime to grant a right of  reply or not to publish an unverified  document? Oh, but they didn't stop  there. They continue their character  assassinations. Look, these are the  darkest people in this country's  history, in the history of its media.  The darkest people. Those who acted as  hitmen during the era of the  AKP-Gülenist alliance, orchestrating  Ergenekon plots against journalists,  taking loans from Gülenist banks to  buy themselves ultra-luxury homes.  Those who said Zekeriya Öz’s statue  should be erected. And then those who,  after being accused of involvement in  illegal betting and shady financial  deals, entering prison and somehow  getting out suddenly, these dark  figures who have been hitmen for every  operation are trying to smear Murat  Arel. Trying to smear Murat A. Look, or  look at a channel where, under the  moderation of a female journalist  I’ve known since my reporting days, a  self-important person claiming to be a  40-year veteran journalist is  slandering Murat Arel. There was İskender Balcı, the  son-in-law of the Treasury and Finance  Minister. At the same time, he was the  son of a BRSA vice president. They have  established a father-son-son-in-law  system, and this is at the root of the  embezzlement. They work as a whole  family. They are robbing us as a whole  family. And here, if you ask what the  father, Mehmet Ali Akben, is doing now,  he is the General Manager of Vakıf  Katılım. Let me try to simplify it  further. Allegedly, this Talat Çakmak  we mentioned did not just take 1  million dollars as a bribe. At the same  time, they inflated these Green Türk  stocks, he bought the stock from there,  and as soon as he sold it at the peak  and the stock dropped, they took the  money and got out. His partner in this  business was the former BRSA  president's son. The person on the  Holding's board and the former BRSA  president, who is currently the head of  Vakıf Katılım, is the one who gave  the establishment permit for an  investment bank to Tera Holding. Mehmet  Ali Akben is the one who gave the  establishment permit, and the man says,  "Look, it wasn't established during my  time," he says. Look at how they play  with words, how they try to deceive us.  They are not transparent at all. Mr.  Mehmet says, "The bank," he says, "was  established in 2023." The permit was  then because, let the intelligence  investigate. Those are very separate  issues. Look at intelligence reports,  clearance reports, this and that. As I  say, this organization is huge. It is  an organization big enough to grant a  bank license to a firm like Tera, look,  Tera which received black money from  Kasım Garipoğlu, a Tera that has  entered the indictment. The man says, " The bank was established in 2023, don't  say 2021," but you gave the  establishment permit in 2021, Mr. Akbel , and inflated the stock with your son  and Taha Çakmak. Now, this brings  something to mind. Bribery through  stock inflation. Does it ring a bell?  How did Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya do it?  She just bought Ozata Shipping stocks,  and instead of selling those shares to  the public, she sold them directly to  Tera with the people's money. Normally,  if you sell on the stock exchange, the  share price fluctuates or something  happens. They always sold them directly  to Tera for the time being. The logic  of that bribery is so similar, isn't it ? In exchange for what? In exchange for  what? What is it really in exchange for ? Now, this father Akbel, meaning the  general manager of Vakif Katilim. The  person who gave Tera its banking  establishment and operating license.  What a coincidence that Taha Çakmak  and his son are steering this operation  together. He said, "We have no  connection with Mehmet Ali Akbel." He  said, "We are just, uh, doing something ." He claims they have nothing to do  with any points or such. Very  interesting. Very interesting  coincidences. Fathers and sons, very  interesting coincidences. Now, one  point to confirm: Taha Çakmak was  arrested, but Turkey Insurance Deputy  General Manager Guroglu Sami Ozer was  also detained. He is having his  statement taken today as well. But look , as we said, there are very  interesting allegations being made so  far regarding the 100 million TL  detected. Turhan Çömez is also an IYI  Party deputy and at the same time a  deputy chairman. He expressed it too.  There is a situation like this. It is  said that all 35 billion liras of  Turkey Insurance Inc. were deposited  into and lost in Tera. 35 billion TL.  If this allegation is true, which they  base on the June 30, 2026, audit report  of Turkey Insurance. They say that,  according to that report, 35 billion TL  was evaluated in investment funds. This  figure is 15 billion in December 2024.  Look, it goes up to 35. It actually  reaches 31 billion in December 2025.  Then, in one year, about 202%...It  increases by 102%. The money in these  funds more than doubles, and it is  thought that a large part of the money  was directed to Tera. And look, if that  money is really in that place, why  isn't it deposited into public bank  funds instead of Tera? Then 1 million  dollars makes a lot of sense, right? Or  if they are returning 70-80 million TL,  it makes sense, but there must be much,  much more. If 35 billion TL in the fund —35 billion TL at Turkey Insurance— was sunk into Tera, we have reached the  end of the line. We are facing a  situation where 35 billion TL of the  citizens 'money, who directly invested  in the insurance company in the Wealth  Fund, has been evaporated, funneled  away, or stolen in Tera. As I said, the  allegation, Turan Çömez is also  expressing this. Or rather, he is  asking. He asks, "Is it like this?" He  asks if these results are like this. So , if it is really like this, if they  have taken 35 billion TL and if that  money from Turkey Life Pension and  Turkey Insurance Inc. is gone, the  severity of the situation seems to  increase with each passing day.  Meanwhile, Yeni Safak newspaper  reported on it. It is actually a very  important development, but it did not  cause much of an echo in public opinion . I don't know if people didn't trust  the news. Actually, they are doing that , too. Uh, I mean, they were confident  in their reports. You know, this  restitution fund is kept at the SDIF.  They tell those who stole our money and  robbed the public, "Come and deposit  into the repentance fund at the SDIF,  then you can go." And you know, Fatma  Betül left that way, too. Now, the  news about it says 25 people have  returned funds. Meaning it was  deposited into the SDIF fund. Uh, when  you look at who deposited, who returned  the money, there was this Astor Energy.  Suddenly, it had become one of Turkey's  largest companies. The guy became one  of the top three richest in Turkey.  They asked the guy, "How did you become  the richest?" The guy says, "I don't  even know, I don't have anything to do  with it," or something. I mean, we  lived through such an absurd period.  This scam is just like that. You know  the owners of this Astor Energy. These  are the Geçgel brothers. Ferudun  Geçgel. Do you know how much they paid , you tell me? They really swindled 5  billion TL into the repentance fund, 5  billion TL. While managing the company,  they swindled 5 billion TL, and they  brought back the money, they returned 5  billion TL. Now there is also Lydia  Holding. They paid 500 million liras.  Uh, the person himself is Enver Çevik.  Uh, this is also very interesting, he  has been known for manipulation reports  for years. They file complaints against  each other. They file lawsuits and all  sorts of things. And Özgür Özel even  made a claim about a company called Bin . He had explained that in that company , these individuals were partners with  Erdoğan's nephew, Mustafa Erdoğan's  son—that is, Erdoğan's brother's son —Üsame Erdoğan, and they had  provided claims that they also had a  share in this scam. Because this is  very strange. A freeze of assets order  was issued for Enver Çevik and Kemal  Hakkay. Then it was lifted, detention,  travel bans were imposed, and so on.  The man always denied it. Now, Bahadır  Özgür had also said regarding this, " Well, it is alleged that he did this  scam," etc. He was constantly refuting  Bahadır Özgür. He had even filed a  lawsuit against Bahadır Özgür. Now,  Enver Bey has returned 500 million TL,  hasn't he? I mean, you did it, you are  confessing now; you didn't just say, " I'm innocent, but I'll give 500 million  TL anyway so as not to be rude," did  you? 500 million TL. I mean, Astor gave  5 billion TL, and he gave 500 million  TL. I mean. According to the Yeni  Şafak report, Mustafa Sandal's wife  and her family had also swindled about  2 billion liras. Uh, they had made 3  billion in profit, sorry. It is said  that they have also applied to return  that. Now a situation emerges where 5  billion from Astor, and 25 people have  now returned 10.3 billion TL, right?  Let's say Astor gave 5 billion. 2  billion, 3 billion from Mustafa  Sandal's wife, she will give that later , let's not count it. And put Fatma  Betül Sayan Kaya in the mix. 2 billion , 2.2 billion, that's already 7 billion . And 500 million from Enver Çevik.  Let the others have some share as well;  there are one or two more names here  from those who came forward. Ufuk  Investment and others, they are  everywhere. Come on man, it already  adds up to something like 9 billion or  so. You say 25 people, now 5 people  paid this. You gathered from these 25  people, gathered and gathered, it’s  80-70 billion Osman uh Nacar. You keep  gathering like this, it doesn’t add  up to 25 people, I mean 10.3 billion  doesn’t make sense. TL, it doesn't  make sense. Who are those 25 people?  Mr. Mehmet, you are so transparent,  really. You are so transparent that, I  mean. At least explain this, come on.  Explain those who made the refunds. I  mean, for those who refunded, say these , these, these names, these 25 people,  say it so we can know what's going on.  And of course, while all these  developments are happening, and these  Astor workers, the ones with these  troubles, you know the factory giving 5  billion TL, the news from your  colleagues at Evrensel Newspaper, the  guy is giving 5 billion uh TL to the  fund, do you know what he is doing in  his factory? He is putting chips on the  workers. Putting chips on the workers.  Tracking chips, he makes the workers  work like that, you know. I mean,  people don't even go to the bathroom  anymore, the workers said while talking . You are very generous while making  these heists. They are putting chips on  the workers. A chip. That is exactly  the reality of capitalism. Then they  rob us. They are robbing the people  again. Those workers are paying the  price for it again. I mean, meanwhile,  there was Imamoğlu's statement  regarding the fund heist. I mean, there  is really striking information there  regarding this whole process. I mean,  his claim there is this, Ekrem  Imamoğlu says, look, March 19 is a  coup, he says. He says a March 19 coup  happened. He says the March 19 coup  happened. Then he describes May 21 as a  coup as well. He says that when these  happened, there were very serious  losses in the stock market. He says  that while these losses were occurring,  look, these fund scammers take action  exactly on those dates. He says they  buy the low stocks when the shares fall , and in those funds, they get the  shares they bought at a low price  because of the conditions caused by  this political instability and  anti-democratic practices, he says.  Then when it rises, he sells, makes a  heist, and drops it again. Ekrem  Imamoğlu draws attention to that. He  says there is a parallelism in these.  He says the IMM case and the operations  against us are connected to the fund  heist. Ah, he also says this: in a way,  since the stock market is a process  where politics—that is, in a sense,  elections could be prevented, the  people's right to vote could be taken  away—whenever there are very serious  drops in the stock market, Tera steps  in, Tera raises the shares. At the same  time, it has a mission. I think this  scenario, this claim of Imamoğlu is  really worth considering. I mean, Tera  is like a state project, like we are  actually connected to the presidency.  We are involved in the whole thing.  Those who invest there think, well,  it's already a state project. One of  the reasons for these funds connected  to this palace might be this. They  might have painted such a picture for  themselves and might have collected the  fallen shares. I mean, Özgür Özel is  also drawing attention to this,  actually. Özgür Özel also says these  things to them. I mean, along with  Imamoğlu, Özgür Özel is also making  statements on this issue. We will get  to the ballot box, we will win the  election, says Özgür Özel at the  same time. Meaning that all these fund  embezzlement scandals haven't been  accounted for, that they are trying to  cover them up, that they are trying to  erase them, and he says, "We will reach  the ballot box and we will win." he  says. By the way, there are interesting  developments happening in the world. I  mean, after Hungary, there was an  important change in Serbia. There is  Vučić who has been in power for 14  years. He was also on the agenda for  building an authoritarian system, for  his desire to be a one-man ruler, and  for his anti-democratic practices. Do  you know what happened, look? There was  an accident at a station, a train  station there. A part of a structure  had collapsed and 16 people had lost  their lives 2 years ago. From that day  to this, the student movement,  especially the protests started by  students, had been continuing. Then the  students fielded candidates against  this person. they turned this into a  platform. They turned those actions  that had been going on for two years  into a political movement, and various  candidates emerged against him in the  form of a coalition, but the student  movement led it. I mean, they also  determined the lists. They defeated  Vučić. Vučić lost the election and  there was also that thing there. There  were questions of whether he would  leave through an election, whether he  would go with the ballot box. It was  claimed that he could make various  moves, but this happened. Yesterday  evening around 8 o'clock, I lost the  election. He said the student movement  won. I congratulated them. He said we  will form an effective opposition and  expressed these words. He left through  the ballot box. Therefore, it is a fact  that you cannot stand in the way of  change. I mean, when change begins,  look, a change started by a student  movement can lead to a historic  transformation and change in Serbia,  and some people do leave through the  ballot box. Goodbye, see you soon.

items.name: Yılmaz Özdil
items.title: Ümit Kocasakal - Yılmaz Özdil
items.transkript: Hello. Today, we will talk about the  Istanbul Bar Association  President-elect, Professor Ümit  Kocasakal, with details you haven't  heard anywhere else in the media, which  I'm sure will surprise you. The Mustafa  Sarıgül issue continues. It’s  burning hot. We will discuss the  Titanic hotels and especially the  legendary KDV shopping center in Berlin , which a Secret Witness alleged was  purchased by Mustafa Sarıgül, with  details and names you have never heard  anywhere else today. Anything else?  Over the weekend, press freedom marches  were held in 10 of our cities,  organized by Journalists 'Associations.  Özgür Özel also participated in the  march in Izmir. We will definitely talk  about that march today. All that,  coming up shortly. But first, the  world's biggest family. First, I want  to take you to Zonguldak. A firedamp  explosion occurred in a private mine in  Zonguldak's Kilimli district. Three  more of our miners lost their lives.  Cengizan, Murat, and Recep are gone.  Cengizan was only 25 years old. His  father was a miner just like him. So,  life hadn't offered him any other  option but the mine, just like his  father. Murat was 38 years old. He had  a son. Recep was 45 years old. Recep  had three daughters. He had three  daughters aged 10, 12, and 17. Recep  had actually retired, but his daughters  were in school. Is his pension enough  to keep sending his daughters to school ? No, it's impossible. He’s forced to  keep working. "I’ll work until the  New Year and then quit," says Recep.  This is how they will end poverty in  Turkey, brother. That’s what I think,  anyway. All the poor people will die in  work accidents. They will die for mere  subsistence. There will be no poverty  left. Because look, there is no need to  be a scientist or a mining engineer or  anything like that. Continuous  measurement must be done with fixed  sensors inside the mine and portable  audio-visual devices, along with  computers at surface stations. If there  is a firedamp explosion, it is  certainly not fate; it means there is a  series of negligence. There is no need  to be an expert. It means these miners  of ours lost their lives because of  negligence. Academic research actually  warns us clearly. Look, academic  research shows that coal seams near the  surface in Turkey are exhausted and  gone. They are forced to go deeper. As  they go deeper, the risk increases.  When the risk increases and precautions  decrease, what happens? What happens  when you replace merit with  subcontractors? The number of mines  isn't increasing, but the death toll is  rising rapidly, and some things never  change. The world's biggest family. I  ask you to look at this photo carefully . Actually, I am asking my editor Erdi  to please help. Erdi, get me in the  frame. Let’s show this photo to our  viewers. Then you can put it back to my  right again. Yes. Look, I ask you to  look at this photo carefully. Yes Erdi,  please bring it next to me. Cotton  trousers on her feet, a hand-knitted  cardigan on her back. A  floral-patterned headscarf on her hair.  When I was just 18 and a cub reporter,  the first time I went to a mine  disaster in my life, women were waiting  like this at the gate of the pit,  brother. At the gate of pits where  firedamp exploded, 40 years have passed , my brother. They are still waiting  the same way, and they are hugging the  coffins at the funeral just like this.  As a man, you might enter that  pitch-black mine to support your family  and provide for your children, but as a  woman, it is hard to wait at the gate.  Indeed, yes. They wait like this in  Soma, too. They wait like this in Kozlu  and in Kilimli, too. They wait like  this in Ermenek as well. It is like  this when it snows. It is like this  under the downpour. She wears printed  baggy trousers. A hand-knitted cardigan  on her back. A floral headscarf on her  hair. Because you can only afford these  clothes with the measly daily wage you  get from entering that grave they call  a mine. You can only afford these for  your loved one, your spouse, the mother  of your children. They are the women of  those blessed men who extract their  pure white bread from those pitch-black  tunnels. Billions of dollars in wealth  are made off their backs, yet they only  have hand-knitted cardigans. Now,  please look. The mine in Kilimli, where  three more of our people lost their  lives, operates under a subcontracting  system. Yes. The mine actually belongs  to the Turkish Hard Coal Authority, but  it is leased to these private companies  via contracts called royalties. That is  how it is operated. It was one of the  first laws the AKP passed as soon as it  came to power alone. The subcontracting  law. Yes. Immediately upon taking  office, they passed it in 2004. What is  this so-called subcontracting system?  It is the name of the system that turns  workers into modern slaves. The  subcontracting system. Look, ever since  this law was passed in 2004, they  reduced safety measures to extract more  coal more cheaply and lower costs. Yes.  They all but whipped the workers.  Deaths in mines accelerated after this  subcontracting law. Yes. Look at the  rate of mining deaths before 2004. And  look after 2004. More coal for more  money, more human lives for more coal.  Billions of dollars are made off their  backs. But this is the state of our  miners and their women. They never  change. They only have hand-knitted  cardigans on their backs. Now, please  look. The Chamber of Mining Engineers  held an occupational safety symposium  in Zonguldak, where this latest  disaster occurred. It was recounted  there. I had taken notes years ago.  Look, let me share it with you. I took  these notes from the Chamber of Mining  Engineers' symposium. During the reign  of Sultan Abdulhamid—you know, the  Abdulhamid they love so much—a  telegram arrives at the palace from  Bartin. It says that in the Mustafa Bey  mine in Cinarli, gas ignited and five  workers were burned. The workers are  afraid to enter the mine. A telegram is  sent to the palace requesting an  investigation. In other words, the  telegram states that firedamp exploded.  The workers inside died. The workers  outside do not want to enter the mine.  They are asking for an inquiry into the  cause of the disaster. The palace  replies on the same day. Yes. A  telegram is sent from the palace. It  says to the Acting District  Governorship of Bartin: "Such injuries  in public mines are inherent to the  nature of mining.""Regardless of where  it happens, as death is a matter of  divine fate, there is no cause to close  any mine; you must advise the workers  to continue production as usual, taking  necessary precautions, and not refrain  from working." Yes. What is the  translation of this into plain Turkish,  brother? The palace says there is no  need for an investigation. These kinds  of accidents are just pretexts. Their  time has come. It was their destiny.  Bury the dead and continue production.  Tell the other workers too. They should  go in and work. "Don't let them upset  us," it says. The palace, I swear by  all that is holy. This correspondence  is in the archives of the Chamber of  Mining Engineers. I am taking it from  the symposium. This is the text of the  correspondence between the Sultan and  the palace. 150 years have passed,  brother. The mentality is the same  subcontracting mentality. There are  subjects, but no humans. They say their  time has come. Bury them and move on. I  said it's fate, didn't I? I suppose  this is how they will end poverty in  Turkey. All the poor will die in  workplace accidents. And there will be  no poverty left. As for the Mustafa  Sarıgül matter, Mustafa Sarıgül's  once-glittering political life has  unfortunately turned into a  Titanic-like disaster. Yes. A secret  witness has been added to the  investigation launched following the  complaint of two Germans. That secret  witness claimed that Mustafa Sarıgül  is a partner in Titanic hotels with his  secret wealth. In this context, Titanic  hotels 'chairman of the board and  vice-chairman, brothers Mehmet Aygün  and Temel Aygün, were taken into  custody. As I am making this broadcast,  they were still in custody. I don't  know if they will be arrested or what  will happen. Furthermore, two years ago , an explicit video surfaced on the  internet. Unfortunately, everyone knows  it. Mustafa Sarıgül had said those  images were edited, the person in the  video was not him, and he was being  blackmailed with that fake video. Now,  the same secret witness in the  investigation has claimed that those  images were actually real and that  Mustafa Sarıgül paid $ 200,000 to get  a report saying they were edited. In  this context, Sarıgül's close  bodyguard was taken into custody. He  gave a statement. He was released under  house arrest. At the same time, a new  investigation was launched into whether  those images are genuine or not.  According to reports reflected in the  pro-government media, there are  confessions from his close bodyguard.  It's worse than the Titanic, really.  Even the love between Leonardo DiCaprio  and Kate Winslet in that Titanic wasn't  watched this closely, my brother. I  mean, Mustafa Sarıgül's career has  unfortunately turned into the Titanic.  So, could there really be a connection  between Mustafa Sarıgül and the  Titanic hotels? When we look at the  Aygün family, who own the Titanic  hotels, we see this: In February 2003,  look, 23 years ago, an event beyond  interesting took place at Berlin Tegel  Airport. The chairman of the board of  Titanic hotels, Mehmet Aygün, and the  then-mayor of Şişli, Mustafa  Sarıgül, who is now being detained,  come to Berlin Tegel Airport to fly to  Turkey. Just as they are about to board  the plane. Bam. They are stopped by the  German police. They are taken into  custody. Yes. Both of them are  interrogated for 12 hours. Why? It  turns out there was the owner of one of  Berlin's most famous beauty centers at  the time, Laakomet. The owner of  Laakomet is the Turkish aesthetic  surgeon Yaşar Sarıgül. His surname  is Sarıgül, but they bear the same  surname as Mustafa Sarıgül. But they  are not related. It is a completely  coincidental surname similarity. So  this aesthetic surgeon in Berlin,  Yaşar Sarıgül, had gone to the  German police and filed a complaint. He  had complained to the police, saying  that Mustafa Sarıgül had come to the  clinic with Mehmet Aygün, beat him up,  choked him, and threatened him with  death. Following this complaint, the  police took Mustafa Sarıgül into  custody at Tegel Airport along with  Mehmet Aygün. So, what did Mustafa  Sarıgül say? According to what was  reflected in the German media during  this 12-hour interrogation, he said  that they had lent 40,000 euros to this  aesthetic surgeon, but the doctor would  not pay his debt, so they went to ask  for the money. That is what the German  media wrote. Upon this statement, the  aesthetic surgeon was asked again. The  doctor also denied this debt issue to  the police. The doctor's wife is also a  medical aesthetics expert. The doctor  had mentioned an issue regarding his  wife. Look, he is saying this from 23  years ago. Mustafa Sarıgül promised  to give my wife a place in Şişli in  return for our support for him in the  municipal elections. But we said this  hostility occurred because we rejected  this offer. Doesn't it feel like a  movie from 23 years ago? There’s  Mustafa Sarıgül, there’s Berlin,  there’s Titanic’s Mehmet Aygün.  There’s a matter of debt and credit.  There are Euros, there’s an alleged  death threat. There is a detention.  Then, I don't know how it happens. They  reach a settlement, they are released.  This incident at Berlin Airport 23  years ago, which was covered up and  forgotten becomes the first news story  where Mustafa Sarıgül and the Aygün  family, owners of the Titanic hotels,  are mentioned together in the media. 23  years ago. Our esteemed media is  completely unaware of this incident,  but the German media follows it very  closely. Because the Aygün family, who  owned a tiny 20-room hotel in Şişli —where Mustafa Sarıgül was mayor at  the time—is a success story that  soared like a rocket in Berlin. The  Aygün brothers, Mehmet—who was  detained at the airport with Mustafa  Sarıgül 23 years ago—and Temel— who is now detained along with his  older brother in this investigation— migrated from Giresun to Berlin and  started with a tiny shop in Kreuzberg,  you know, what's known as the Turkish  neighborhood. They start by selling  döner. Döner in bread. They turn that  tiny shop, that döner stand, into a  restaurant chain across Berlin in a  very short time. They turn them into  Hasır restaurants. Anyone who has been  to Berlin knows. It doesn’t end there . They turn it into a five-star Titanic  hotel chain in Turkey. They turn it  into 14 luxury hotels in Antalya,  Istanbul, Bodrum, and Kocaeli. That  doesn’t end there either. They turn  it into a 5-star Titanic hotel in  Berlin as well. They open it. The  German media has always viewed this  financial success story, which shot  from zero to billions of Euros, with  suspicion. In prestigious and popular  publications, such as magazines like  The Berliner, they make insinuating  comparisons. About this Mehmet Aygün.  They make comparisons like "the Vito  Corleone of Anatolia" and so on. Yes.  German magazines compare this closed  business model, consisting only of  family members, to "The Godfather" due  to its influence over local politics,  local bureaucracy, and local power  centers, its armor of immunity, and its  very strong lobby in Turkey. Yes. That  is the German media's comparison. And  as is clearly seen in the incident at  Tegel Airport, the friendship between  the Aygün family and Mustafa Sarıgül  goes back at least a quarter of a  century. At least. It must be a  coincidence, but Mustafa Sarıgül  becoming the mayor of Şişli in 1999  coincides with the same period that the  Aygün family turned into a financial  rocket both in Berlin and Turkey. A  coincidence. And the investigation  currently being conducted by the  Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's  Office is focused precisely on this.  Was this success story built with  döner money, or was it built with  Mustafa Sarıgül's money? They are  looking into that. It is alleged that  Mustafa Sarıgül is a partner of the  Aygün family with his secret wealth,  and this claim is being investigated.  Right now. Another huge claim, again by  a secret witness in the investigation,  is related to Berlin again. Always  Berlin, huh. It is claimed that Mustafa  Sarıgül moved his unregistered wealth  abroad through couriers and shell  companies and bought the iconic  shopping center KaDeWe in Berlin. A  secret witness. This is also in the  investigation. This is being  investigated. Turks in Germany know the  place called KaDeWe very well. It is  truly an extraordinary place. Every  time I go to Berlin, even if I don't  shop, I visit it just for the visual  pleasure. KaDeWe, founded in 1907, is  one of Europe's most historic, largest,  and most luxurious department stores. They actually defeated both the  cuckoo bird operation and the cuckoo  eggs all at once. This is the result of  the election at the Istanbul Bar  Association. Lawyers from various  political backgrounds have locked onto  each other with the cement of Mustafa  Kemal. At the Istanbul Bar Association,  by looking at life through the window  of Ankara, they stood by the Atatürk  Republic, which is the prescription for  salvation for all our problems. That is  the result of the election at the  Istanbul Bar Association. Professor  Ümit Kocasakal and the patriotic  lawyers who supported him had succeeded  in becoming the branch Turkey could  hold onto during the previous Bar  presidency period, especially during  the setup periods, the Ergenekon and  Balyoz eras, by not staying silent, by  resisting, taking an active role,  holding firmly to the rule of law, and  not backing down in the struggle for  judicial independence and democracy. It  is certain that it will be the same  again now. In the absence of Professor  Ümit Kocasakal, the well-known  republican and Atatürkist lawyers  unfortunately fell into infighting.  Nationalist lawyers and others, the  votes were split. Thus, for the first  time since the AKP came to power, the  Istanbul Bar Association election was  lost. İbrahim Kaboğlu had won with  the Second Republican and pro-PKK team.  Who was İbrahim Kaboğlu? As soon as  he was elected President of the  Istanbul Bar Association, in his very  first speech, his very first thank-you  speech, he targeted the first four  articles of the constitution. Yes. He  said the unchangeable articles could be  touched upon in a positive sense. On  İbrahim Kaboğlu's management list,  there was also the lawyer of the  lawyers of PKK leader Abdullah Öcalan.  Yes. I mean, for the first time in  history, Abdullah Öcalan's lawyer had  entered the management of the Istanbul  Bar Association. Furthermore, on  İbrahim Kaboğlu's board of directors,  there were lawyers who called the  Turkish Armed Forces' struggle against  the PKK a massacre and said they would  not be partners in the massacre. Yes.  There was the president of the Laz  Association, who was being tried on  grounds of promoting Laz separatism.  Yes. There is a lawyer who advocates  for Laz to be a language of education  and says the phrase "How happy is the  one who says I am a Turk" harms the Laz  people. Yes. I just said it. There were  lawyers of PKK members in the  management. Of course, everyone,  including PKK members, has the right to  legal defense. Without a doubt, it is a  constitutional right. But is it  important in terms of showing the  worldview of those who are PKK lawyers?  The PKK has a lawyer organization. An  association. The president of that  association was on this İbrahim  Kaboğlu's board of directors. In  İbrahim Kaboğlu's management, there  was someone who said we can call the  east of Ankara Kurdistan. Yes. There  were those who defended the Ergenekon  setup, right? This İbrahim Kaboğlu,  whom Professor Ümit Kocasakal defeated  with an overwhelming majority, was a  jurist the AKP was very fond of when it  came to power. Yes. The AKP adored him.  During our leader of the century's  prime ministry, for example, he was  appointed head of the Prime Ministry  Human Rights Advisory Board. But then  what happened? His expiration date  passed. He was put out the door like an  empty milk bottle. He was even fired  from the university by a decree  suddenly issued by our leader of the  century. What happened when he was  fired? He ran as fast as he could. He  took refuge in Kılıçdaroğlu. Yes.  He was made a CHP deputy by  Kılıçdaroğlu, right? Yes. He  prepared a draft constitution  containing divisive demands on behalf  of the CHP, Turkey's founding party. He  wrote in demands such as changing the  definition of citizenship and bilingual  education; he became a candidate again  in the last 2023 elections, but this  time he was not made an MP. Because  this time he returned and became the  President of the Istanbul Bar  Association with the explicit support  of the DEM Party and this current new  party. Professor Ümit Kocasakal and  patriotic lawyers defeated this entire  coalition together with this İbrahim  Kaboğlu administration. So, who is  Professor Ümit Kocasakal? Someone who  lives a very clean life at home, with  his family, and in his private life. He  says: "My wife is the foundation of my  philosophy of life." He says. "Being  married to such a person is the  greatest achievement of my life." We  miss them, don't we? Such people.  Someone who has always kept the child  within him alive. Ümit Kocasakal. For  instance, he owns one of the most  impressive comic book collections in  Turkey. Yes. You know, Mr. Tom Mix,  Texas, Captain Swing, and he is a huge  fan of Zagor. He is crazy about Zagor.  Why does he love these comic books so  much? He says they claim they are  harmful to children, but he believes  they are extremely beneficial. Why?  Because, he says, there is no blood or  sexuality in them. In these comic books , the good always win and the bad  always lose. With 3,000 CDs. Look, it's  no exaggeration, he has a collection of  3,000 films. He has a very rich  collection of black and white Turkish  films. He says Belgin Doruk, Zeki  Müren, Türkan Şoray, Filiz Akın— every society has a chemistry. The true  chemistry of the Turkish people lies in  those black and white films. He says  those Turkish films are the values that  bind us together. "To me, one of the  most important duties of every family  is to have their children watch old  Turkish films." He says. If this  society ever forgets Zeki Müren, Ayhan  Işık, or Eşref Kolçak, that is the  day it ends, he says. That’s the kind  of person Ümit Kocasakal is, a fan of  Turkish art music whose idol is Zeki  Müren. That is actually why his  daughter's name is Yasemin. "A bouquet  of jasmine, the only souvenir of my  love." It comes from there. If their  second child had been a girl, it would  have been Manolya. "I can't bring  myself to smell my beautiful magnolia."  When it was a boy, they couldn't use it . He has 33 and 45 RPM records. He  really likes Turkish light music. He  loves İlhan İrem, Yeni Türkü, Grup  Gündoğarken, and Edip Akbayram very  much. He has all the records of Ferdi  Özbeğen and Ümit Besen. Professor  Ümit Kocasakal has a 400-CD collection  of Greek music. He owns all the works  of Bach, Mozart, Beethoven, and Vivaldi . A magnificent collection. He says  that 20-30 years ago, Turkish people  were much happier. Go out on the street  now. Everyone is tense, everyone is  unhappy. Because our people miss the  old Turkey, he says. True. Isn't it  true? "I am not aggressive, but I do  not have a conciliatory personality."  He says. He says, "I do not feel  obliged to compromise with anyone  regarding the fundamental qualities of  the Republic." He says he neither shows  empathy nor sympathy regarding the  fundamental qualities of the Republic.  It bothers me that the USA and the  European Union like me. They  manufactured a plastic understanding of  religion in their laboratories. No  crusade has ever caused as much damage  to the Islamic faith. He says they are  exploiting our people's emotions by  passing off Saudi Wahhabism as Islam.  Similar to the late Professor Yaşar  Nuri Öztürk, whose memory we honor,  he says there is a massive distortion  in Turkey. They use concepts that none  of us can oppose, such as democracy,  brotherhood, and human rights. They  deceive the public with big lies. He  says the biggest of these is the lie of  "national will." They pass off the  voters 'preference as the "national  will." They do not consider those who  do not vote for them as part of the  nation. Whereas what is essential is  not the national will. It is national  sovereignty, and sovereignty belongs to  the nation. Look, especially you young  people, listen closely because I think  it’s very striking. He says if two  paths appear before you, never choose  the easy one. Climb uphill. Follow the  bloody footprints. He says the path  shown as easy never leads to happiness  or a good place. Look at history, he  says. Look at history. In history, the  last word has always been spoken by  those who resisted. Yes. I have never  hidden who I am in my life. I wear an  Atatürk badge. I have an Atatürk  corner in my home. And I love the photo  of Atatürk with hearts the most.  Because that picture gives us strength  and a spirit of resistance in today's  conditions. he says. I am a Kemalist,  he says. I am a soldier of Mustafa  Kemal, he says. I am against the use of  Atatürk as a fake mask. I embrace  Atatürk’s ideological legacy. I am a  nationalist, I am a patriot, he says.  He says nationalism is not a boogeyman,  as some try to make it appear. What is  wrong with valuing national interests  above imperialist interests, he says?  What is wrong with it? They say the  nation-state is dead. Then why doesn't  it die in Germany or France? They  ruined Turkey's chemistry. They messed  with its genetics. They released two  deadly viruses into the country. One is  the ethnicity virus, the other is the  sect virus. The antivirus is Kemalism,  he says. Should I repeat it? I will.  They ruined Turkey's chemistry. They  messed with the country's genetics.  They released two deadly viruses into  the country. One is the ethnicity virus , the other is the sect virus. The  antivirus is Kemalism, says Professor  Ümit Kocasakal. This is it. When he  joined the CHP in 2018, stepped down as  head of the Istanbul Bar Association,  and became a candidate for CHP leader,  I was at Sözcü Newspaper at the time.  In my column in Sözcü, I wrote an  article addressing the CHP's party  delegates and asked them a question. I  like Ümit Kocasakal a lot, both as a  person and in terms of his mindset. We  also have some personal history. Some  people who wanted to get me convicted  paid millions of dollars to Professor  Ümit Kocasakal as a lawyer. The  professor refused to act against me. He  pushed the money away with the back of  his hand like this. I never forget it.  I was at Sözcü Newspaper. Before the  2018 congress. Especially dear young  people, please read it by underlining  it. Please listen by underlining it. I  had asked by writing an article  addressing the CHP's congress delegates . Is it Mehmet Bekaroğlu, who calls  Kemal an infidel, who said "Not enough  but yes" in the "Not enough but yes"  referendum, who defended the conspiracy  cases by saying the Ergenekon  defendants are mentally ill, who was  brought into the party management via  the women's quota despite having a  mustache, who is a political Islamist,  who openly says he is not a CHP member,  who says the six arrows are problematic , who says one should say "from Turkey"  instead of "Turkish nation"? Ümit  Kocasakal. I asked this in my column,  young people. Listen by underlining it,  I asked this. What else did I ask? I  said, is it Sezgin Tanrıkulu, who is  alleged to have leaked information to  the CIA's covert organization with the  code number TR705 and who wants to  change the definition of citizenship in  this written constitution? Or did I ask , is it Ümit Kocasakal? I asked the  CHP delegates. I further said, are  those within the CHP who were elected  as CHP deputies and proposed reopening  the lodges and convents, recommended we  read Risale-i Nur, asked us to pay our  respects to FETO, and characterized the  1915 events as genocide, or is it Ümit  Kocasakal? What else? Are they types  like Ekmelettin İhsanoğlu, who was  brought from Egypt to be the CHP's  presidential candidate as if there were  no men left in the country, or did I  ask, is it Ümit Kocasakal? In 2018,  the party is heading to a convention.  Is it Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu, who keeps  losing election after election? They  are asking, is it Ümit Kocasakal? They  are asking, is it Kemal from Dersim, or  is it a soldier of Mustafa Kemal? It is  impossible to reclaim Turkey without  reclaiming the CHP. I asked, is it the  cuckoo eggs or Ümit Kocasakal? 2018.  The result was the convention. It did  not prefer Ümit Kocasakal. It  preferred the others. Ümit Kocasakal  could not even become a candidate for  chairman. He remained a preliminary  candidate. Because he could not collect  enough signatures to be a candidate at  the convention. They didn't give them.  They didn't even give him signatures so  he could go out and compete  democratically. It didn't stop there.  They expelled him from the CHP with  some dirty tricks. Yes. Look, in the  same year as the convention, 2018, they  made this İbrahim Kaboğlu a deputy in  the CHP. They expelled Ümit Kocasakal  from the CHP. Yes. People like İbrahim  Kaboğlu, along with political  Islamists, lodge and convent supporters , genocide cheerleaders, Soros  supporters, and the darlings of the PKK . Where was Özgür Özel while they  were being made deputies in the CHP? He  was the CHP's group deputy chairman. He  was walking around by  Kılıçdaroğlu's side like his bag.  Isn't that right? With the schemes of  the cuckoo eggs, they didn't even allow  Ümit Kocasakal to be a candidate for  chairman. They expelled him from the  CHP. Then they say "Atatürk is our red  line" and all, but they went and  supported İbrahim Kaboğlu with this  mask. They had him elected as president  of the Istanbul Bar Association to the  seat vacated by Ümit Kocasakal. Yes.  They say "Atatürk is our red line" at  rallies. The CHP of failure and this  new party of the solution process  broker were divided on every issue, but  they were in agreement on İbrahim  Kaboğlu. Yes. What does Mustafa Kemal  say? There are hopeless people. There  are no hopeless situations, he says.  That's how it happened. It went around  and ended up like this. After the Izmir  Bar Association, the genetic memory of  the Republic's founding values won in  the Istanbul Bar Association as well.  Therefore, I am updating and asking  again today what I asked the CHP  delegates before the 2018 convention. I  am asking again. If Professor Ümit  Kocasakal had been elected CHP chairman  in 2018, or even if he wasn't elected  chairman, if he had been made a factor  in the party with a strong signature  count and a strong vote; instead of the  cuckoo eggs, instead of the  towel-sellers and bag-sellers, if today , instead of deputy chairmen who have  indictment after indictment for  corruption against them, our qualified  people like Ümit Kocasakal had been  made CHP administrators, would the CHP  be experiencing the situations it has  fallen into today? Would there have  been a split between the CHP and the  New Party? If Ümit Kocasakal had  become the CHP chairman or had been  made a factor in the party as I said,  if people like Ümit Kocasakal had been  chosen as administrators, and if the  mayoral candidates had been selected  with that vision. Now, could the  innocent suffer alongside the guilty  like this? Should healthy apples be  packed in the same crate as rotten ones ? Could Turkey's founding party be  dismantled in this way? As citizens, we  wholeheartedly congratulate Ümit  Kocasakal. By the way, day after  tomorrow, on Thursday, is our Republic  Day, October 29th. Shall we have a  brief reminder? Look, 103 years ago On  the morning of October 29, 1923, the  day the Republic was proclaimed, our  population was 13 million. Yes, 11  million people lived in villages; out  of a 13 million population, 11 million  were in villages. We had 40,000  villages. There were no schools in  37,000 of our villages. There were no  post offices. There were not even shops . In 30,000 of our villages, meaning  three out of every four, there were no  mosques. The number of tractors was  zero. The number of combine harvesters  was zero. There was only the primitive  wooden plow. There was no sunflower  production. There was no sugar  production. There was no agricultural  production. Even bread flour was  imported. Rice was imported. In the  whole country, only 5,000 hectares of  land could be irrigated. In 5,000 of  our villages, there was cattle plague.  Animals were dying off, people were  dying off. 1 million people had  syphilis, my friends. Look, a  population of 13 million, 1 million  people had syphilis. 2 million people  had malaria. 3 million people had  trachoma. I am sure our youth will go  on the internet now and search for what  trachoma is. Because it has disappeared  from our lives. Back then, 3 million  people had trachoma. 13 million  population, 3 million people with  trachoma. There were epidemics of  tuberculosis, typhus, and typhoid. Lice  infestations could not be managed. The  infant mortality rate was over 40%. One  out of every two babies born was dying.  The maternal mortality rate was 18%.  One out of every five mothers was  losing their life in childbirth. The  average life expectancy was only 40;  those who saw age 41 were lucky. There  were only 337 doctors in the country.  337; there were only 60 pharmacists,  and only eight of them were Turks. The  number of dentists was zero. We had  only 4 nurses in the entire country.  40,000 villages, and only 136 midwives.  The number of burned buildings was  115,000, and damaged buildings 12,000.  We had just been liberated from  occupation. The number of villages  completely turned to ash was over 1,000 . It was necessary to rebuild the  country. There weren't even roof tiles.  Even roof tiles were being imported.  Our ports and our mines belonged to  foreigners. Our dear palace had handed  them over on a silver platter. Not even  one meter of the railways belonged to  us. Only 15%of the total capital was  Turkish. From the Ottoman era, only  four factories remained standing.  Hereke Silk, Feshane Wool, Bakırköy  Cloth, Beykoz Leather; there was  nothing else. In 96%of the enterprises  called industry, there was no motor.  There were only 280 workplaces  employing more than 10 workers. And 250  of these already belonged to foreigners . National income per capita was only  45 dollars. Electricity was only  available in Istanbul, Izmir, and  Tarsus. "Existence" would be a generous  term. Because the electricity  production was only 50 kW. Yes, you  heard that right. Just 50 kW; there  were no highways usable in all four  seasons. No rain, no winter travel,  nothing. Only if the weather was nice.  The number of automobiles was 1,490,  and private cars were only in four  cities. We were already in ruins. On  top of that, 400,000 of our people  arrived via the population exchange.  400,000. No money in their pockets, no  work. No home to take shelter in. No  relatives they could turn to. They had  come through the population exchange.  Most of them were sick, too. One in  every two children who arrived lost  their lives within the first two months  on the backs of horse-drawn carts on  the roads. I know this from my own  family. There were babies who died on  the roads on their mother’s side.  There were those who had to live in  caves out of desperation. Yes, in a  cave. Women were not considered human.  They had no right to equal education.  They had no right to have a profession.  They had no right to divorce. They had  no right to child custody. They  didn’t even have the right to manage  their own inherited property. They had  no right to vote. They had no right to  be elected. There was no maternity  leave. They had no equal rights in  working life. They had no right to  equal pay for equal work. They had no  right to abortion. They had no right to  contraception. They had no right to use  their maiden names. Women were not  human. They were conducting a census.  They were counting the cows. They were  not counting the women. No theater, no  music, no painting, no sculpture, no  sports. Archaeological artifacts were  smuggled to Europe by train as gifts  from the sultans. Some used the " alaturka" time. They accepted the  moment the sun set as 12 o'clock. Some  used the "zevalli" time. They accepted  the moment the sun was at its zenith as  12 o'clock. Others based it on the " grubi" time at sunset. Some based it on  the "ezani" time when the sun had  completely set. I mean, when you asked  "what time is it, brother," everyone  gave a different answer. Some used the  Hijri calendar. Some used the Rumi  calendar. Someone's February  corresponded to another's December.  Everyone was in the same time zone but  living in different months. There were  dirhems, okkas, and chekis. There were  arshins, fathoms, and leagues. Neither  our weights could keep up with the  world. Nor our lengths; all our  measurements were Medieval. The Middle  Ages. For 600 years, the Turkish  language was essentially violated. The  blend of Arabic and Persian was called  Ottoman Turkish. French and Italian  words, and Levantine terms, had invaded  our language. They were trying to write  Turkish with Arabic, which doesn't have  the corresponding vowels and consonants . It doesn't even have the matching  vowels and consonants. They were trying  to write Turkish with Arabic. The  alphabet revolution took place. People  say, "We were made illiterate in one  night," or something like that. But in  the 150 years since Ibrahim Muteferrika , the number of printed books was only  417. Yes. Most of these came out of  non-Muslim printing houses, and Ibrahim  Muteferrika himself was a convert. By  the time books reached these lands, 2.5  million different books had been  printed in Europe. 5 billion books had  been sold. Books still hadn't arrived  in these lands. Voltaire, for instance,  says in one of his books that,  unfortunately, what is written in  Istanbul in a year is less than what is  written in Paris in a day. Yes.  Newspapers only existed in Istanbul and  Izmir. Only 7%of men and 0.4%of women  were literate. The overwhelming  majority of literate men were either  officers or non-Muslims. Three out of  every four school-age children could  not go to school. They were not going.  Because there were only 4,894 primary  schools, 72 middle schools, and only 23  high schools in total. In the capital,  Ankara, for example, there were only  two high schools. There were only 230  female students in all of Turkey's high  schools. One-third of the teachers  didn't even have any teacher training.  There was only one university in the  whole country. Darülfünun. It wasn't  much better than a madrasa anyway. The  country was very far from science.  Turkish was forbidden in the madrasas.  They were nests of bigotry. They teach  superstition in the name of religion.  October 29, 1923. The Republic moved  forward under these very conditions.  The Republican revolution is a miracle.  A miracle. As Mustafa Kemal said, there  are hopeless people. There are no  hopeless situations. Do not let your  spirits down. Long live the Republic.  Long live for 1000 years. Atatürk. We  will never give up on you or your work.  That's all for today. Please don't  forget to subscribe, like, comment, and  share. Actually, today I was going to  talk about the Mecca agreement brought  to the Grand National Assembly of  Turkey. I had said so, but since hot  agenda topics took over, I didn't want  to squeeze it in. Because I want to  tell the story of the Mecca agreement  as a mini-documentary, with details  you've never heard anywhere else and  never been told, and figures that I am  sure will surprise you, especially to  entrust it to the digital archives of  our precious youth. God willing, I will  explain it in my Friday broadcast. I  will probably hold a draw among my  subscribers. As always, I will choose  by a random method. On the occasion of  Republic Day, I will gift one lucky  viewer the only framed photo of Mustafa  Kemal that sits in my own home library.  Wherever we are, wherever we live, I  celebrate the Republic Day of everyone  who looks at life through the window of  Ankara in advance. See you on Friday  morning. Farewell.

items.title: Öğrenciler Sırbistan'da Siyaseti Nasıl Yeniden Kurdu?
items.transkript: Böylesine kriz dönemlerinde asla hep yeni umutlar çıkmıştır, yeni çözümler çıkmıştır. Bakınız Sırbistan. Sırbistan'da öğrencilerin organize ettiği bir hareket 12 yıllık Vučić iktidarını devirdi. Avrupa'nın en otokrat şeyinden bahsediyoruz. Asla bırakmaz diyorlardı, asla yıkılmaz diyorlardı. Tıpkı Macaristan'ın eski başbakanı gibi. Kaybetse bile devretmez diyorlardı. Hem kaybetti hem de seçim sonucunu kabullendi, paşa paşa eee devretti. Şimdi de diyorlar ki ama bu öğrenciler nasıl yönetecek? Ya gerçekten hani adamlar nasıl kazandığına kafa yoracağına şimdi yönetemezler falan. Ya Vučić nasıl yönetiyordu ki? Neydi ki Vučić de şimdiki, şimdiki adam en azından profesör yani baktığınız zaman. Şimdi bu Sırbistan örneğini çok iyi bakmamız lazım. Çünkü niye? Bakın hep bizim gibi ülkelere ya da şeylere hep bir şey dayatılıyor. Ya ocusun ya bucusun. Ya şöyle iki elini kafanı, iki elini arasına alıp düşünmeye zamanın olmuyor. Ya kardeşim ben ocu da değilim, bucu da değilim yani. Niye ocu bucu olayım ki ben yani? Ya ona karşısın ya da değilsin. Eee yani ben ona karşıyım diyelim. Bunun yanında mıyım yani? Bunun da, buna da karşıyım ben. Diyemiyorsun. Deditmiyorlar. Çünkü diyor ki başka alternatif yok diyor. Aa olur mu diyor, hep beraber diyor gidip oy vereceğiz diyor. Oysa bak gördüğünüz gibi Sırbistan bambaşka bir şey başardı. İsterseniz bu hikayeyi Arda'yla konuşalım. Arda biraz filmi geriye alalım. Çünkü 2024'te bir tren kazasındaki bir kazayla başlıyor hikaye. Kaza da değil ha. O kazanın ardında bütün bu sistemin yolsuzluğu var, bürokrat yolsuzlukları var, istismar var, liyakatsizlik var, siyasetçiler var. Çok tanıdık hikayeler var orada yani. Evet dinleyelim. Ne yaptı öğrenciler de bu başarıya geldiler? >> 1 Kasım Novi Sad tren faciası. Biz aslında o zaman da konuşmuştuk ve o günden itibaren 2 senedir yaklaşık Sırp Eee, öğrenciler, gençler sokaklarda Çinli bir şirketin de yer aldığı demiryolu modernizasyon çalışmalarından birinde o sırada devam ederken bu kaza gerçekleşiyor ve eee, can kaybı 16'ya yükseliyor. Zaten bu 16 rakamı üzerinden 16 dakikalık her gün bir eee, saygı duruşu, sessizlik ve kırmızı el. >> Kırmızı >> Tabii ki. >> Şimdi bak kaza demeyeceksin. Kaza dediğin zaman sanki gerçekten bir kazaymış gibi. Çünkü ben bunu sırf arkadaşlarımdan dinledim. >> Doğru. >> Eee, orada bir renovasyon var. Bu renovasyonları farklı yerlerde de yapıyorlar ve orada bir rüşvet dönüyor. Ve o yüzden de layıkıyla yapamıyorlar. Layıkıyla yapmadıkları için de şey çöküyor. Tavan çöküyor, 16 kişi ölüyor. Diyorlar ki ya bu burada şey yapın ya, bunu soruşturun. Burada bu bir kaza değil, cinayet gibi bir şey. Vučić diyor ki hayır. Çünkü Vučić'in adamları bu işi organize etmişler, o bürokratlar. Yani bunun üzerine gitmiyor. Onun üzerine eylemler başlıyor. Her gün 16 dakika. Şimdi devam edelim. >> Aynen öyle. İhmal olarak zaten yorumluyorlar bunu. Her gün 16 dakika eylemler devam ediyor. İşte kırmızı el, bu da sorumlusu var. Bu bir kaza değil, bürokratlar buna rüşvete göz yumanlar bunun sorumlusu diye aylarca süren işte neredeyse 22 ay süren protestolar en sonunda öğrencilerin Vučić'i devirdiği bu dün düne Belgrad'dan gelen bu görüntülere ki bir ay önceye kadar bu kadar bekledikleri bir şey de değil ama son bir ayda liste açıklandıktan sonra anketlerde de öne geçiyorlar ve cuma günü de hatırlıyorsunuz anketlerde bir iki puan öndeler. Gerçekten de kazanabilirler diyorduk. Gerçekten de kazandılar. Bir son duruma bakalım. Aynen öyle. Şu an 140 milletvekili sokacaklar. Yani 125 burada %50, onun da üzerine çıktılar ve tek başına iktidar olacak öğrenci listesi. Vučić kaybetti ve kabul etti. Vučić dedi ki biz 1.7 milyon oy aldık, onlar 2.2 milyon oy aldı. Görünen o ki biz kaybettik ve kabul ettik. Biliyorsunuz cumhurbaşkanlığından istifa etti sırf güçlü bir aday olarak kendi partisinden başbakan olarak seçilebilmek için. Daha önce de yine başbakan olarak başlayıp, cumhurbaşkanlığına gelmişti. İki görevini de bırakmış oldu. Hem başbakanlık hem cumhurbaşkanlığı gitti. Öğrenciler kazandı ama Cüneyt Bey muhalefet kazanmadı. Çünkü öğrenciler bu listeye hiçbir eski muhalefet partisinden kimseyi sokmadı. Orada kalıtsallaşmış, yıllardır 12 yıl boyunca Vučić'e kaybeden muhalif listelerden de kimseyi almadılar. O adamların oğullarını, kızlarını da almadılar. Yani asıl siyasi statükoyu resmen bozmuş oldular. Bunu da nasıl yaptılar? Yatay örgütlenme yaptılar. Dikey örgütlenme değil. Eee insanları halktan seçtiler. İşe kimleri aldılar? Sağlıktan bir kardiyolog şu anda. O da başbakan adayı diyorduk ama o da başbakan olup olmayacağı belli değil. Yani sadece parti, yani listenin lideri olarak gösterilmiş. Belki yarın başkası seçilecek. Hukuktan avukatlar, eğitim akademisyenler, ekonomi profesörleri. Eee şu eski bir basketbolcu, şu anda EuroLeague'in yönetiminde. Avrupa basketbolunun önde gelen isimlerinden biri. Teknik meslekler, tarımdan çiftçiler, gazeteciler, girişimciler, emekliler. Yani yatay bir liste oluşturdular. Daha önce siyasete hiç bulaşmamış. Aslında Vučić'in karşısında ya da önünde olmayan isimleri topladılar ve onu yatay bir şekilde yaptılar. Yatay ne demek? Bir parti lideri gelip, bir öğrenci lideri gelip "Bu, bu, bu, bu olacak." demedi. Hatta daha önce eski eee Belgrad Üniversitesi rektörünü listenin başına koydular. Sonra bir oylamada o da gitti. Yani öğrenciler onu da seçmek istemedi. Bu kadar eee ince eleyip sık dokudular. Aynı zamanda listeleri de son bir aya kadar açıklamadılar. Çünkü medya nın, Vučić'in aslında elinde bulundurduğu, o zamanki iktidara yakın medyanın bu isimleri karalamasından, üstüne skandallar yıkmasından da çekindiler. Buna da engel oldular. Üniversite blokajları yaptılar ve plenum sistemi. Burada grafiği getirebiliriz. En önemlisi bu. İşte bu plenum sistemi tam anlamıyla eee isimlerin tek tek bir kişi tarafından değil, doğrudan aday önerileri tarafından eşit oylama sonucu belirlenme sistemi. Aslında üniversitelerde olduğu gibi. >> sistemi? Yani nasıl çalışıyormuş? Biraz bilgin var mı o konuyla ilgili? >> Eee şu şekilde bir genel başkan seçmiyor. Öğrenci genel kurulları tek tek aday önerileri koyuyor. İşte bunun sonucunda da en çok liste oy alan adaylar eee 250 kişilik listeyi oluşturuyor. Zaten 250 kişi parlamentodaki sayı ve bunların tam 140'ı şu anda parlamentoya girmeyi başardı. Bu açıdan çok önemli. Yani aslında yakalanmamak için, iktidar tarafından takip edilmemek için listeleri de son gün açıkladılar. Öğrenci bir aday da yok. Bu da çok önemli. kendilerini de aday göstermediler. Dediler ki biz burada sorumluluğu alıyoruz. Biz öğrenciler, üniversite öğrencileri biz bunu örgütleyeceğiz üniversitelerde, meydanlarda ama siz seçileceksiniz günün sonunda. Kardiyologlar, avukatlar, işte eski eğitim eee görevlileri sizler olacaksınız karar vericiler dediler. Kendilerini destekleyen güçlü isimleri bile elediler dedim ya. Belgrad Üniversitesi rektörünü başta seçip çağırdı. Sonra oylama plenum sistemi sonrası gitti, kazanamadı, listeden çıktı. Kimse de ya bir dakika bana söz vermiştiniz. Burada aday ben olayım demedi. Yani biraz burada tanıdık muhabbetler. Hani ya kimse kırılmasın, kimse üzülmesin. Çok büyük siyasi emeği var. İşte bu kişinin karşısında 20 yıl eee muhalefet yapmıştı. Bunların gözünün yaşına bakmadılar. Çünkü böyle kazanamayız. Önemli olan bizim orada temsiliyet şeklinde girmemiz şeklinde düşündüler. Siyasi çizgileri de sağ sol kimliğinden ayırdılar. Burada Sırp Sırbistan biliyorsunuz çok milliyetçi bir ülke. Bu çocukların arasında milliyetçiler yok mu? Kesinlikle var. Ama içi boş bir milliyetçilik mi yoksa gerçek bir milliyetçilik mi? Sorusunun cevabını aradılar bence meydanlarda. İşte gerçekten ülkesini seven, yolsuzlukları, bürokrasideki tıkanmışlıkları ortadan kaldırmak isteyen gençler de belki solcu diyeceğiniz, daha dinine eee işte Sırp milliyetçiliğine uzak gençlerle burada bir arada yer aldı. Zaten inanılmaz da görüntüler geliyor Cüneyt Bey. Bakar mısınız? Yani Belgrad yangın yeri gerçekten 2 sene boyunca devam >> Yangın yeri ama yanlış şey ha yanlış kullanma. Yangın yeri derken şey gibi yani yani, metafor olarak kullanıyorsun. Çünkü hiçbir şeyi eylem, yani, hiçbir talan, polisle çatışma ya da ne bileyim, yağma, hiçbir şey yapmadılar. Sadece halaylar çektiler, 16 dakika sessizce yürüdüler. Son derece barışçıl ve bu yürüyüşlerinde hiçbir siyasi partinin bayraklarını taşıtmadılar, taşımadılar. Ya, adamlar, hani, Sırbistan'da siyaseti sıfırladılar aslında. Yani, siyaset 101'i getirdiler. Böyle bir Ayn Rand romanı vardır. Ayn Rand romanlarından çıkmış bir sonuç elde ettiler yani. Bir, toplumun en iyi temsil edilen isimlerini parlamentoya sokmayı başardılar. Yani, günümüz demokrasilerine örnek olabilecek bir şey, biliyor musun? Ve günümüz partilerine ders olabilecek bir şey.

Oğuz Alper Öktem eee, bir zafer kazandı diyebiliriz. >> Evet. Valla ben bu tür şeyleri, uygulamaları destekliyorum. Yani dünyanın her yerinde kullanılıyor. Türkiye'de yasak ya da yasaklanmaya çalışılıyor. Ya bu bütün dünyaya, bütün teknolojik gelişmeye karşı çıkmak gibi bir şey sonuçta. Ya gidiyorsun dünyanın her yerinde işte Uber kullanabiliyorsun. Şimdi Türkiye'de Uber kullanabiliyor musun? Kullanamıyorsun. Neden? Bir tek taksiciler var. Taksici lobisi buna izin vermedi bir şekilde. Dünyanın her yerinde kullanabiliyorsun ama bu da aynı şekilde yani artık millet şeysiz şoförsüz arabaya geçmiş durumda ya. San Francisco'da iki ayrı şirket var şoförsüz araba. Yani millet işte ne bileyim Tesla artık alıyorsun arabayı araba kendi kendine çalıştırıyor falan. Böyle gidiyor taksi yapıyor. Şoförsüz bir şekilde aldığın araba. Biz hala acaba olsun mu olmasın mı o mahkeme bu mahkeme tuhaf zorluklarla mücadele ediyoruz. Şimdi Kenan konuşacak çok konu var. Sırbistan Brezilya seçimleri var. Fransa ve eee önümüzde Fransa'da, İspanya'da seçimler var. İsrail'de seçimler var. Dünya yeni bir eee yeni bir yönetim biçimine doğru gidiyor. Yani eski liderler koltuklarını kaybediyor. Sırbistan'da çok ibretlik bir başarı var. Öğrencilerin başarısı. Hem iktidarı hem de muhalefeti yendiler öğrenciler. Yani ikisini birden yendiler ve farklı bir siyasetin mümkün olabileceğini bütün dünyaya gösterdiler. Buna büyüteçle bakacağız. Ne yaptılar da bunu başardılar? Nasıl başardılar meselesini ele alacağız. Ama ilk olarak şu fon, eee, fon yangınıyla devam edelim. Buna fon krizi mi diyelim, fonzi mi diyelim. Artık herkes kendine göre bir isim takıyor. Şimdi hafta sonu ilginç gelişmeler yaşandı. Bunlardan bir tanesi, en önemlisi AK Parti'nin bir dönem reklam işlerinin başında olan önemli bir isminin Ertan Aydın'ın tutuklanmasıydı. Ertan Aydın önce ev hapsine alındı. sonrasında tutuklama geldi ve de Tera'daki yöneticiliğinden dolayı eee tutuklandı. Şimdi önemli bir tutuklama aslında. AK Parti'nin içinde ilk kez hani daha siyasi kimliği olan birisi tutuklandı bu şeyde. Ama bir yandan da eee diğer tutuklamalar devam ediyor. Eee bürokratların tutuklamaları devam ediyor. Şimdi aslına bakarsanız bu fon krizi biraz daha artık önümüze çıkmaya başladı. Yani biraz daha resim belirginleşiyor. Belirginleştikçe de aslında şunu görüyorsunuz. Bu aslında bir bürokratların organize ettiği kriz. Yani siyasiler de var, göz yummuşlar, başlarını başka bir yere çevirmişler ama aktif olarak bu işi organize eden, hisseleri patlatan, izinleri veren, görmezden gelen bizzat bürokratlar olmuş. Bunu bir tek ben söylemiyorum. Mesela eee hafta sonu ilginç bir açıklama vardı. eee, Nihat Zeybekçi. O da bir fon mağduru. O da aynı şeyi söylüyor. Hatta o isim isim sayıyor. Yani diyor ki, "Bak bu kurum, bu kurum, bu kurum, bu kurum yaptı bunu." diyor. Yani şeyde eee bir izleyelim isterseniz. Bakın nasıl sayıyor. Fon meselesi maalesef yaklaşık olarak 6 tane kamu kurumunun ihmali var. İhmali. [boğazını temizler] kamu görevlilerinin ihmal bazılarının üst derecede ihmal ve maalesef bazı kamu kurumlarının yönetiminde de hem ihmal hem suistimal ama bunlar biz bir hukuk devletidir. Yani hiçbir zaman için hukuk devletinde yani şey gibi demokratik olmayan ülkelerde alın şunu götürün şunu diyemezsiniz. Hukukun işlemesi lazım. Sistemin çalışması lazım. Ama bu kurumların ihbali net. Bakın hiçbir şey gizlenemez. Özellikle bu dönemde bu bilgi çağında, bu kayıt çağında hiçbir şey gizlenemez. Bunların hepsi ortaya çıkacak. Yani vurgun yapanlar diye bir ordu var. Bir de vurgun yiyenler var. Onların içinde bizim şirketlerimizde var. Şundan emin olun. Bu kardeşimiz 7 yaşı diyelim akıl vali olduğum andan bugüne kadar hesabını veremeyeceğim bir tek nefesim dahi yoktur. >> [alkış] >> Şimdi Nihat Zeybekçi de fon mağduru bildiğim kadarıyla. Kenan ne kadar parası kalmıştı fonda Nihat Bey'in? 250 milyon civarındaydı Cüet Bey. >> 250 milyon civarında. Tabii bir zamanların ekonomi bakanıydı. Biz de hatta demiştik ki ya ekonomi bakanının bile eee bir anlamda dolandırıldığı ya da fonda kaldığı bir ortamda eski ekonomi bakanının yani kimlerin başına neler gelmez dedik. Şimdi hafta sonu eee biraz önce eksik söyledim. Dedim ki bu bir bürokrat organizasyonu. Bürokratlar organize ettiler. Görmezden geldiler. İşin bir parçası oldular. Üstelik yalnız da değillerdi. Kimilerinin oğulları da vardı. Şimdi böyle bir şey oğlunu koyar mısın? Normalde koymazsın. Fakat öyle bir sistem kurulmuştu ki oğullar da bu işin içindeydi. Şimdi mesela oğullara dokunulmaya başlandı. Babalara şimdilik dokunulmuyor. Kimdi o dokunulan oğullar? Ve biraz şu ilişkiyi anlatır mısın? Hafta sonu ilginç bir tutuklama daha geldi. Biz cuma günü duyurmuştuk. gözaltını kim tutuklandı? Ve bu babalar ve oğullar ilişkisini mesela Yıldırım Ayoğur iki gündür yazıyor. Çok güzel özetliyor. Aşırı rastlantılarla dolu bir eee ilişki ağı var orada. >> Taha Çakmak Türkiye Sigorta Genel Müdürüydü. Uzun süredir konuştuğumuz bir isimdi. O tutuklandı. Onun yanında da aslında Türkiye Sigorta Genel Müdürü Yardımcısı Gürol Sami Özer de tutuklandı. Şimdi bu iki tutuklamamız vardı. Aslında Ta Çakmak adını yaklaşık biz 10 gündür konuşuyoruz. Önce onunla ilgili ilk bildiğimiz bilgileri söylememiz gerekiyor. Burada bir e Tereya Türkiye sigortanın parasını yatırıyor ve o para yatırdığı paranın karşılığında da 1 milyon dolar elden para aldığını biliyorduk. Eee geçtiğimiz 4 gün önceye kadar bildiğimiz şey buydu. Sonrasında bir savcılık ifadesi ve savcılıktaki adliye kaynaklarının iddiasına göre yeni bir mesele old oldu oldu orada. O da şu Grek hissesi yani Grein Türk diye bir şirket var. Onun hisselerini Tera alıyor. Peki Tera nasıl alıyor? Tera'ya daha çakmak diyor ki siz bu Green Türk hisselerini alırsanız teraya ben bu başında bulunduğum şirketin parasını sizlere yatıracağım iddiası var. Bu bir iddia. savcılık iddiası olarak bunu vermemiz gerekiyor. Şimdi Green Türk'ü de eee biraz daha detaylı olarak incelememiz gerekiyor. Oradaki Grek meselesinde eee Yıldıray'ın ve Denizli Zeyre'in de sabah yazısı vardı. İkisinin yazılarında eee çakışan bilebir noktalar var. Grentürk'teki yönetim kurulu üyelerinden birisi Ahmet Emir Akben. Kendisi 32 yaşında. Şirketin de denetim komitesinin başkanlarından birisi. Peki Ahmet Emir Akben kim? BDDK eski başkanı Mehmet Ali Akben'in oğlu. Peki Mehmet Ali Akben kim? Uzun yıllar yaklaşık 3,5 yılda da 4 yıl Taha Çakmak'la beraber çalışmış bir isim. Eee Taha Çakmak biliyorsunuz bundan önceki görevi 2019'la 2021 arasında 2 yıl eee BDDK başkan yardımcılığı görevini yapmıştı. Buraya kadar soracağınız bir şey var mı? Eklememiz gereken? >> Şimdi biraz karışık bir hikaye. Bilmeyenler için şöyle özetleyelim. Mehmet Ali Akben bir açıklama yaptı zaten. Dedi ki ya bunların hepsi tesadüf. Yani benim çocuğumun orada olması, onun arkadaşının tutuklanıyor olması hepsi bir tesadüf diyor. Fakat bunlar aşırı tesadüfler. Yani bu kadar tesadüf de gerçekten hani eee insan yani şaşkınlık şaşırmaktan kendini alamıyor. Ne kadar büyük tesadüfler var. Şimdi biliyorsunuz bu Tera nasıl patlatıyordu şeyleri? Daha önce bir denizcilik şirketinde yaptığını görmüştük. Şimdi bu Grey Grek'le bu şirkette de yaptıklarını görüyorlar. Grein Türk'ün ilk grafiği getirdiğin zaman onu getir. Daha öncekini getir. Heh. Şimdi bakın burada Ahmet Emir Akben var. Mehmet Ali Akben'in oğlu. Genç bir isim. Öyle yaşlı başlı değil. Gözünüzde şey canlanmasın ama çok başarılı. Yani bir üniversiteden mezun oluyor. Bir anda Vakıf Bank'ı New York şubesinde çalışmaya başlıyor mesela. Yani gerçekten büyük başarı. Sonra geliyor Grein Türk'ün içine giriyor. Yönetim kurulu üyesi oluyor ama bağımsız yönetim kurulu. Şimdi bizdeki yönetim kurulları aslında şirketlerde çok da iyi çalışmıyor. Özellikle bir aile şirketi ise biraz böyle dostlar alışverişte görsün. Yönetim kurulları var. Oysa devlet özellikle bankalar krizinden sonra yeni bir yasa çıkartıp dedi ki ya bu yönetim kurullarını biraz daha aktif hale getirmek lazım. Bir de birer tane de bağımsız bir üye olması lazım. Şimdi normal şartlarda bu bağımsız üyeler niye olacak orada? İşte eğer şirkette hani olmaması gereken bir şey olursa o bağımsız üye müdahale edecek. Fakat bizdeki işleyiş nasıl böyle değil. Genelde bağımsız üyeyi de şirketten yani CEO ya da o şirketin sahipleri seçiyorlar. Biraz dostlar alışverişte görsün bir hali var. Pek çok şirket hepsinde demiyoruz. Şimdi burada tıpkı bu Özata Denizcilik gibi GreinK diye bir şirketten haberdar oluyoruz ve bu Greinturk şirketine Tera'nın tıpkı diğer şirketlere yaptığı gibi kendisi gidip %20 hisselerini alıyor ve de yavaş yavaş yavaş yavaş şişiriyor. Şimdi buradaki zaten sıkıntı şu ya bu Tera'nın bu işe girmesi rastlantı bu ya. Gidip GreinK'ü alması birinci şeye gel eee grafiğe gel. İşte Green Türk'te de o dönemin BDDK başkanlığı Mehmet Ali Akbe'nin genç gencecik sayılabilecek oğlu Ahmet Emir Akben'in şey oluyor olması eee üye oluyor olması. Şimdi Mevdali Akben açıklama yaptı. Dedi ki ya benim zamanda banka kurulmadı dedi ama bir şey atlıyor. Onun zamanında banka izni verilmiş. Çünkü bürokratlar da şu anda daha önce demiştim ya yakan topu karşı sahaya atıyorlar. Çünkü niye? Eee şu andaki BDDK başkanı kim? Eski Merkez Bankası Başkanı. Peki ne zaman geldi? 2023 yılında geldi Şahap Bey.
